messages.text: The serialized result isolates a desktop timing race in the visual list: the selected control updates, but the previous server result remains painted past the assertion window, while the identical mobile API path succeeds. I’m adding an immediate projection of the already server-loaded catalog for the selected model while the authoritative API response replaces it; this preserves the backend boundary and removes stale-result flicker instead of weakening the browser test.
